abilities.name: Mark Target
abilities.description: Once per encounter, as a Free Action, you may spend 4 Hope to mark one enemy you can see as the Marked Target. That enemy's current HP total is immediately revealed to your whole party and updates visibly whenever it changes. The Mark lasts until that enemy is defeated or the encounter ends.

abilities.name: Next One's Mine
abilities.description: Once the Marked Target is defeated, you may immediately mark a new target, following all of Mark Target's normal rules, even though you've already used it this encounter.

abilities.name: No Cost to Know
abilities.description: Mark Target no longer costs Hope to use.

abilities.name: Data Trail
abilities.description: As long as you've found somewhere the Digimon you're looking for has actually been, you may make a Trace check against DN 8 to figure out where they went from there.

abilities.name: Open Season
abilities.description: Any attack made against the Marked Target by an allied Tamer or an allied Digimon gains a bonus equal to your Knowledge rank to both its hit roll and its damage.

abilities.name: Set the Board
abilities.description: At the start of an encounter, you may make a Command check against DN 10. On a success, you may move one enemy and one ally 2 spaces each before the encounter's first round begins.
